reference: MATPOWER case9 branches/main loads plus the historical auxiliary 50 MW pure-R load; ratings matched, NOT electrical equivalence
model_scope: Independent balanced-source EMT variant: ideal voltage equivalents, benchmark coupling reactances, constant-Z loads; no synchronous-machine/AVR/governor dynamics
line_representation: One lumped pi per unsplit branch; selected branch split into two proportional pi sections. Length parameter=1 km is electrical normalization, NOT a claimed physical line length.
zero_sequence_assumption: R0=R1, L0=L1, C0=C1: uncoupled-phase pilot assumption, not supplied by case9 and not qualified for LG/LLG or realistic unbalanced clearing

fault.snubber_policy: R2024b default resistive snubbers across phase contacts; finite off-state leakage is modeled, not deleted from raw signals
fault.clearing_semantics: SPS breaker current-zero extinction may follow command; command is not an independently observed switch-state label

limits: Crossline diagnostic, not dataset generation or adoption.
Historical public labels; internal matrix order retained and explicitly mapped.
Only the selected pi line is split: moving the fault also moves that lumped-pi segmentation.
Unqualified zero sequence and ideal-source/constant-Z assumptions remain.
No independent breaker-state telemetry; preserve all raw startup/event samples.

electrical_calibration.source: Frozen E15 build_audit/power_flow: source voltages and physical main-load impedances held across locations

matrix_indexing: INTERNAL case9 matrix order; public SLX/CSV/figure bus labels use the paper IDs

scenario.current_direction: B8 towards B7; receiving current has the SAME direction

candidate_limits: Generation authorized; numerical/physical/publication qualification NOT established.
345kV static-source, constant-Z 365MW/115MVAr case9-derived network, not original230kV.
All14E16 voltage failures retained; no new solver-accuracy certification.
Paper kilometer coordinates assigned to fixed case9 total RLC; original per-km equivalence not established.
Selected-line lumped-pi segmentation/snubber position changes with location.
Only one timing, resistance and operating point; no independent contact-state telemetry.
Bus currents are derived; B6 main current excludes separately logged50MW auxiliary.
Shared events across views are not independent test samples; no old folds reused.

spatial_contract.convention: Historical line coordinate; case9 total RLC allocated proportionally, not old-network calibration
